pins.name: T_CLK
pins.notes: Clock, shares the SPI bus with the display

pins.name: T_CS
pins.notes: Chip select of the touch controller: its own pin, not the display's

pins.name: T_IRQ
pins.notes: LOW while the screen is touched

gotchas.text: Give the touch controller its own chip select (T_CS). It shares the clock and data lines with the display, so two chip selects on one pin lock both up.

source.title: XPT2046 touch controller datasheet
source.section: SPI interface: DOUT is high impedance while CS is HIGH

gotchas.text: It returns raw 12-bit numbers (0 to 4095) for X and Y, not pixels. Calibrate the corners of your screen once and map the numbers to pixels in code.
T_IRQ goes LOW while the screen is pressed. Use it to read the position only when there is a touch.

sources.title: LCDwiki 3.5inch SPI Module ST7796 (MSP3520) user manual
